name: hr-open
label: HR-Open Standards

table_notes.hro_person_profile: Core identity record for any individual in the HR system — employee, candidate, or contractor.
table_notes.hro_position_opening: Defines a job vacancy including type, FTE ratio, compensation band, and posting lifecycle status.
table_notes.hro_candidate: Aggregates resume data (work history, education, skills, certifications) linked to a person profile.
table_notes.hro_application: Tracks a candidate's pipeline progress against a specific position opening, from submission to offer.
table_notes.hro_employment: Active or historical employment contract record linking a person to a position with compensation and schedule terms.

hro_person_profile.name: id
hro_person_profile.description: Unique identifier for the person record

hro_person_profile.name: family_name
hro_person_profile.description: Legal family name (surname) of the individual

hro_person_profile.name: given_name
hro_person_profile.description: Legal given (first) name of the individual

hro_person_profile.name: preferred_name
hro_person_profile.description: Name the individual prefers to be addressed by (may differ from legal name)

hro_person_profile.name: date_of_birth
hro_person_profile.description: Date of birth used for age verification, benefits eligibility, and compliance

hro_person_profile.name: gender
hro_person_profile.description: Self-identified gender (HR-Open GenderCodeList: Male, Female, Undisclosed, NotApplicable)

hro_person_profile.name: nationality
hro_person_profile.description: Primary nationality as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. US, GB, DE)

hro_person_profile.name: primary_language
hro_person_profile.description: Primary spoken/written language as IETF BCP 47 tag (e.g. en-US, fr-FR)

hro_person_profile.name: communication
hro_person_profile.description: Contact channels: {phone: [{use, dialNumber}], email: [{use, address}], web: [{use, uri}]}

hro_person_profile.name: primary_address
hro_person_profile.description: Structured mailing address: {line, city, countrySubdivision, postalCode, countryCode}

hro_position_opening.name: id
hro_position_opening.description: Unique identifier for the position opening

hro_position_opening.name: job_code
hro_position_opening.description: Internal job classification code from the organization's job catalog

hro_position_opening.name: job_title
hro_position_opening.description: Human-readable title for the position as posted

hro_position_opening.name: job_category
hro_position_opening.description: Occupational category (O*NET or ISCO-08 code recommended for interoperability)

hro_position_opening.name: position_type
hro_position_opening.description: Engagement type: DirectHire, Contract, Temporary, Internship, Volunteer

hro_position_opening.name: full_time_equivalent
hro_position_opening.description: FTE ratio for the position (1.00 = full-time, 0.50 = half-time)

hro_position_opening.name: organization_unit
hro_position_opening.description: Department or cost center responsible for this position

hro_position_opening.name: work_location
hro_position_opening.description: Work site details: {address, remote: bool, onsite: bool, travel_percentage}

hro_position_opening.name: compensation_range
hro_position_opening.description: Advertised pay band: {minimum, maximum, currency (ISO 4217), intervalCode (Hour/Week/Year)}

hro_position_opening.name: posting_date
hro_position_opening.description: Date the position was publicly posted or internally advertised

hro_position_opening.name: target_start_date
hro_position_opening.description: Desired start date for the successful candidate

hro_position_opening.name: status
hro_position_opening.description: Posting lifecycle state: Open, OnHold, Filled, Cancelled, Expired

hro_candidate.name: id
hro_candidate.description: Unique identifier for the candidate record

hro_candidate.name: person_id
hro_candidate.description: References hro_person_profile — links candidate to their identity and contact data

hro_candidate.name: profile_status
hro_candidate.description: Talent pool availability: Active, Passive, Hired, Withdrawn, DoNotContact

hro_candidate.name: employment_history
hro_candidate.description: Array of past roles: [{employer, title, start, end, description, reasonForLeaving}]

hro_candidate.name: education_history
hro_candidate.description: Array of credentials: [{institution, degree, fieldOfStudy, start, end, gpa}]

hro_candidate.name: skills
hro_candidate.description: Array of competencies: [{name, proficiencyLevel, yearsExperience, lastUsed}]

hro_candidate.name: certifications
hro_candidate.description: Array of certifications: [{name, issuingAuthority, issueDate, expiryDate, credentialId}]

hro_candidate.name: ref_notes
hro_candidate.description: Array of professional references: [{name, title, company, relationship, contact}]

hro_application.name: candidate_id
hro_application.description: References hro_candidate — the applicant submitting this application

hro_application.name: position_id
hro_application.description: References hro_position_opening — the role being applied for

hro_application.name: applied_at
hro_application.description: Timestamp when the application was submitted (UTC)

hro_application.name: status
hro_application.description: Disposition status: Active, Withdrawn, Rejected, Hired, OnHold

hro_application.name: stage
hro_application.description: Current pipeline stage: Applied, Screening, Interview, Assessment, Offer, Background

hro_application.name: source
hro_application.description: Recruitment channel where the candidate originated (e.g. LinkedIn, Referral, JobBoard)

hro_application.name: assessment_results
hro_application.description: Structured evaluation outcomes: [{assessmentType, score, maxScore, completedAt, notes}]

hro_application.name: offer
hro_application.description: Formal offer details: {salary, currency (ISO 4217), startDate, expiryDate, status, terms}

hro_employment.name: id
hro_employment.description: Unique identifier for the employment record

hro_employment.name: position_id
hro_employment.description: References hro_position_opening — the position this employee fills

hro_employment.name: employee_id
hro_employment.description: Employer-assigned employee badge or payroll number (unique within the organization)

hro_employment.name: start_date
hro_employment.description: Official employment start date (hire date for statutory calculations)

hro_employment.name: end_date
hro_employment.description: Employment end date; NULL indicates currently active employment

hro_employment.name: employment_type
hro_employment.description: HR-Open EmploymentTypeCodeList: FullTime, PartTime, Contract, Temporary, Seasonal

hro_employment.name: compensation
hro_employment.description: Active pay details: {base, currency (ISO 4217), intervalCode, bonus, equity, effectiveDate}

hro_employment.name: benefits
hro_employment.description: Enrolled benefit plans: [{planType, planName, provider, coverageStart, coverageEnd}]

hro_employment.name: work_schedule
hro_employment.description: Working pattern: {hoursPerWeek, daysPerWeek, shiftCode, flexibleWork, remoteAllowed}

long_description: HR-Open Standards (formerly HR-XML) is the IEEE/ANSI-backed standard for HR data exchange. The schema covers the complete hire-to-retire lifecycle: job postings (PositionOpening), candidate profiles with employment/education history, applications with assessment results, and employment records with compensation data.
when_to_use: Use for any HR information system, applicant tracking system (ATS), or HR integration platform that must exchange data with third-party HR vendors. HR-Open is used by SAP SuccessFactors, Workday, and ADP for integration APIs. Essential for staffing agency systems and background check integrations.
